title: AAP grant reference (broker profile, section 4.2)
description: The one fully pinned AAP wire artifact: the opaque logical grant name an agent presents to the broker. ABNF: grant-reference = "grant://" 1*(unreserved), with unreserved per RFC 3986 (ALPHA / DIGIT / "-" / "." / "_" / "~"). Deliberately less expressive than backend-and-path schemes; it MUST NOT encode a backend, path, or credential shape. The `not` keyword rejects a line break: under Python's `re.search`, which the jsonschema package uses, `$` also matches before a final line break, so the pattern alone admits `grant://orders-db` followed by one, which an ECMA-262 engine rejects.
